examName: Maharashtra Education Service, Group B (Collegiate Branch) - Lecturer in Zoology
examPattern: Written Examination / Screening Test followed by Document Verification or Interview

topics: Concept of species and speciation
Characteristics of the subkingdoms-Protozoa, Parazoa and Metazoa
Evolution of symmetry, segmentation and coelom in Metazoa
Protozoa: Locomotion, Reproduction, Life cycle of Leishmania, Life cycle of Plasmodium, Life cycle of Paramoecium, Parasitic protozoans and diseases
Porifera: Canal Systems, Skeleton
Coelenterata: Structure and life history of Obelia, Metagenesis, Polymorphism in Coelenterates, Coral reefs and their significance
Platyhelminthes and Aschelminthes: Life Cycle of Fasciola hepatica, Life Cycle of Taenia solium, Life Cycle of Ascaris, Parasitic adaptations, Pathology and control of helminths - infecting man
Annelida: Earthworm - Feeding and digestion, circulatory system, excretory system, Coelom and coelomoducts in annelids, Filter feeding

Arthropoda: Salient features and phylogeny of Onychophora, Crustacean larvae, Mouth parts in insects (cockroach, mosquito, honey bee and butterfly), Metamorphosis in insects, Social life in termites and honey bees
Mollusca: Salient features and phylogeny of Monoplacophora, Torsion and detortion in Gastropoda, Respiration in various groups of Mollusca
Echinodermata: Water canal system, Echinoderm larvae and their phylogenetic significance, Mechanism of locomotion and feeding in starfish, Asterias
Protochordata: Structural organisation and affinities of Balanoglossus, Retrogressive metamorphosis in Urochordata, Feeding mechanism in Amphioxus
Pisces: Migration in fishes, Respiratory organs and mechanism of respiration in fishes, Receptor and effector organs in fishes

Amphibia: Origin of Amphibia, Parental care, Anatomical pecularities and affinities of Urodela, Apoda and Anura, Neoteny, Morphological and physiological aspects of Metamorphosis in frog, Hibernation and Aestivation

Reptilia: Adaptive radiation in reptiles, Mesozoic reptiles, general characters and affinities of Sphenedon, Significance of temporal vacuities in classification of reptiles, Non-poisonous and poisonous snakes of India, General characters, aquatic adaptations and conservation of Chelonia
Aves: Origin of birds, Flightless birds of world, Palate in birds, Bird migration, Flight adaptations in birds, Orientation and homing in birds

Mammals: Dentition in mammals, Integument and its derivatives, General characters of Prototheria, Metatheria and Eutheria, General Evolution of horse and man, Comparative account of aortic arches, urinogenital system, heart and brain in various groups of Chordata
Osmoregulation & Thermoregulation: Osmoregulation in freshwater and marine fishes, Osmoregulation in terrestrial animals, Poikilothermy and homeothermy
Physiology of digestion
Physiology of respiration, respiratory pigments
Cardiac cycle, pace maker and blood composition and functions
Physiology of excretion
Eye and its working
Ear and its working
Structure and functions of Endocrine glands: Hypothalamus, Pituitary gland, Thyroid, Parathyroid, Islets of Langerhans, Adrenal, Pineal
Chemical nature, source and mode of action of aminergic, petidergic and steroidal hormones
Hormonal control of reproduction in male and female mammals
Mechanism of impulse conduction and synaptic transmission, Neurotransmitters
Physiology of muscle contraction
Role of abiotic factors (temperature and light) on animal life
Impact of inter and intraspecific biotic factors
Types of ecosystems
Energy flow and food chain at trophic levels
Biogeochemical cycles
Biosphere, Impact of ozone layer, Greenhouse Effect
Methods and importance of water conservation, water quality standards and interlinking of rivers in India
Adaptations: in freshwater animals, in desert animals, in marine animals, in terrestrial animals

Pollution: Air pollution, Water pollution, Land pollution, Biodegradation, biotransformation and biomagnification of pollutants, Trace metals as pollutants, Municipal solid waste disposal, Pesticides as pollutants and their toxic effects on plants, animals and soil
Wild Life: Present status of wild life in India, Sanctuaries and National Parks in Maharashtra, Project Tiger and conservation of tigers, Red Data Book, Endangered and Biome Restricted Species
Ethology: Diurnal and seasonal rhythms, Biological clock, Impact of hormones and pheromones on behaviour, Modes of communication in animals, Physiology of learning in animals, Mimicry and coloration
Structure and functions of cell organelles: Plasma membrane, Mitochondria, Golgibodies, Endoplasmic reticulum, Ribosomes, Nucleus, Cytoskeleton
Cell division: Mitosis, Meiosis, Cell cycle events at molecular level, Apoptosis
Chromosome - structure and function, Lampbrush and Polytene chromosomes
DNA structure and function: Watson - Crick model of DNA, Replication of DNA in Eukaryotes and Prokaryotes, Types of DNA and RNA, Mitochondrial DNA
Genetic code
Gene transcription and translation

Genetics: Mendel’s Laws of inheritance, Crossing over, linkage, multiple alleles, Polyploidy, Mutations (gene and chromosomal), Genetic significance of blood groups, Genetic disorders in man, syndromes

Molecular Biology and Biotechnology: Eugenics, Cloning techniques, cloning vectors, Cell line preparation, Types and application of stem cells, Haemopoietic system, Applications of cloning technology in medical and veterinary sciences, Human Genome, DNA finger printing, Transgenic animals, PCR, Southern and Western blotting, SDS-PAGE

Bioinformatics: Introduction to Bioinformatics, Bioinformatics tools/Softwares, Protein sequence databases, Genome databases, Phylogenetic analysis, Bioinformatics and Pharmaceutical industry, National Centre for Biological Information

Biochemistry: Structure of carbohydrates, lipids, amino acids, proteins, saturated and unsaturated fatty acids, cholesterol and steroids, Energy reactions - Glycolysis, Krebs’ cycle, Electron transfer chain, Oxidative phosphorylation, Nature of enzymes, Mechanism of enzyme reactions, Vitamins - types, sources and functions

Immunology: Immunoglobulins and Immunity, antigenic and antibody vaccines, DNA vaccines and edible vaccines, Monoclonal antibodies, Cellular and humoral immune reactions, Innate and Adaptive immunity, AIDS - causes and remedies, ELISA

Gamete Biology: Mechanism of spermatogenesis, oogenesis, vitellogenesis and egg membrane formation, Molecular mechanism of Fertilization, acrosome reaction and sperm penetration, In-vitro fertilization, sperm preservation, Parthenogenesis - causes, mechanism and significance, Types of eggs

Embryology: Types of cleavages, Types and mechanism of gastrulation, Foetal Membranes and their functions, Formation, types and functions of Placenta, Organizer concept and embryonic induction, Mechanism of regeneration
IVF: Embryo transfer techniques, GIFT, Test tube baby, Male and female contraceptives and population control, Immunocontraception
Development: Organogenesis of nervous system, eye, heart and kidney in frog, Teratogenesis in man, Aging in man
Economic Zoology: Vermiculture, Prawn Culture, Sericulture, Apiculture, Lac culture, Pearl culture, Fish culture (Freshwater and marine), Poultry
